title: Property Preservation Desk Note: Occupancy Finding Allowance on a First Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Rule.** For the first extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case whose borrower has died, the most recent occupancy inspection finding on the borrower's occupancy profile (Occupancy and Residency Certification) adds days to the extension length:

- Where the finding is that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower, 15 calendar days are added.
- Where the finding is that the home is vacant, 7 calendar days are added.
- Any other finding, or none, adds nothing.

**Same-day findings.** Where two occupancy inspection findings carry the same most recent date, a finding that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower prevails over a finding that it is vacant, and a vacant finding prevails over any other finding.

| Most recent inspection finding | Days added to the extension length |
|---|---|
| occupied by someone other than a borrower | 15 |
| vacant | 7 |
| any other finding | 0 |
| no finding on the profile | 0 |

## Hypothetical profiles

- Latest inspection: vacant. 7 days are added.
- Two inspections on the same latest date, one occupied by someone other than a borrower and one vacant. The occupied finding prevails, so 15 days are added.
